sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully encodes the conditional universal device-presence requirement on each linked other survival craft, preserves explicit true/false applicability selection, and does not incorrectly require craft existence.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Replace the SPARQL constraint with the required conditional SHACL Core qualified minimum-count encoding: when shipOperatesInLowAirTemperature is true, apply a value shape to every nltl:hasOtherSurvivalCraft value requiring sh:minCount 1 on both nltl:hasLocationSignalDevice and nltl:hasOnSceneCommunicationDevice. Do not impose explicit rdf:type checks on linked devices: the canonical relationship ranges already identify the device concepts, while requiring asserted types can create false violations. Preserve the false applicability alternative and do not add sh:minCount 1 for other survival craft, since the universal rule does not require craft existence.

Candidate faithfully encodes the conditional universal device-presence requirement on each linked other survival craft, preserves explicit true/false applicability selection, and does not incorrectly require craft existence.
